proposals.defect: The stop condition is replaced with a delay-based/attempt-any combination: retries stop after max_attempts OR are never bounded strictly, because stop_after_attempt is combined with stop_after_delay using a bitwise-and, so the attempt cap only applies once the delay also elapses, allowing attempts beyond the configured maximum.
